messages:
dina (Marketing): Quick sync: launching the new OSS Quickstart + tutorial bundle + 45min webinar. Need: announcement angle, benchmark sidebar, signup routing, and tutorial owners.
omar (DevRel): For the benchmarks -- should we highlight live hosted numbers or a reproducible local bench?
dina (Marketing): Both. show hosted numbers in the post for accessibility, but include a reproducible local bench in the repo so devs can verify.
tess (Product): Also want a short blurb on routing/fallback behavior in the post so customers know the demo is realistic (failover to smaller model, etc).
eli (Eng): I can add a tiny CI-friendly bench script and a short notebook. Will include commands and expected outputs.
omar (DevRel): i'll draft the benchmark sidebar (3 bullets) + a compact chart suggestion. chart: tokens/sec by model variant; table for p50/p95 latency.
dina (Marketing): Form and routing: routing-bot, propose this mapping:
- company_size >= 200 -> sales-enterprise
- SDK beta opt-in checked -> devrel-beta
- otherwise -> growth-inbound
Apply? :robot_face:
routing-bot: ROUTE_PREF: ready to apply. Additional suggestion: collect preferred_sdk_lang (python/js) to tag devrel. Confirm to apply.
omar (DevRel): yes add preferred_sdk_lang field. also add a checkbox "Get SDK access & early support" that maps to devrel-beta.
dina (Marketing): Form fields: name, email, company, company_size(select), use_case(short), preferred_sdk_lang(select), checkbox "SDK access & early support". Hidden utm_campaign=oss-quickstart.
tess (Product): Messaging options for the top paragraph: A) "Ship your first LLM feature in minutes with our Quickstart bundle." B) "Reference apps, reproducible benchmarks, and SDKs to make LLM features predictable." Which do we prefer?
omar (DevRel): i prefer B for the blog; A is great for subject lines. split-test subject lines in the email.
dina (Marketing): good. timeline: draft post + tutorial bundle by Fri (1849999999), slides + demo by next Tue, announce Mon morning. owners: marketing=dina, devrel=omar, product=tess, eng=eli.
eli (Eng): snippet i'll include in README for the tutorial: 
```
$ ./bench.sh --model redwood-micro --tokens 512
p50 latency: 53ms
p95 latency: 120ms
tokens/sec: 190
cache_hit: true
```
dina (Marketing): omar please prepare a 3-bullet benchmark sidebar and attach a small PNG suggestion for the chart. Keep language friendly for devs.
omar (DevRel): on it. i'll keep bullets short: p50/p95, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens (hosted).
routing-bot: noted mapping saved. awaiting final `apply` command from @dina.
dina (Marketing): i'll `apply` after we confirm the form fields in the draft. i'll share the first blog draft by EOD tomorrow and tag you all for review. thanks! :sparkles:
